text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you watch the Kikuka Sho the other day!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I saw it, I saw it, I saw it! Man, it was insane~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Symboli takes the lead!
A deafening roar from the crowd! A massive cheer erupts at Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A magnificent flower has fully bloomed under the overcast skies of Kyoto Racecourse! The Triple Crown Umamusume, 8 wins in 8 starts!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A Classic Triple Crown that will carve its name
into our nation's Umamusume history has been achieved!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Backed by tremendous cheers,
she extends brilliantly down the final straight!
âIt's Symboli Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "That was amazing! C.B. is strong, but Rudolf is really something else too!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf might actually be the one
to go beyond five crowns and take six!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, it's always Rudolf this, Rudolf that.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
CB, even though you have the raw talent to become the strongest Umamusume in history...!
Why can't you find the motivation?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Our voices aren't reaching her, are they...?
I wonder if she'll still smile today, even if she loses...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All the runners are on edge.
Yeah... I'm getting excited.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Once those gates open, it's our world.
Now, let's do this...!

As if leaving the murmurs of the stands behind,
she began walking straight ahead.
âThe curtain rises on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
